However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration.

For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C Senior Divisional Finance Manager- Mumbai Central, Western Railway . The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date 3. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of Senior Divisional Finance Manager- Mumbai Central, Western Railway A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses SCOPE OF WORK Hiring of One Vehicle for Use of Sr DCM/BCT for a Period of Two Years. 1. Governing Documents The contract shall be governed primarily by the General Conditions of Contract (GCC) for Services, 2018, including all applicable correction sli ps, amendments and Railway Board instructions issued from time to ti me. The GeM Contract/SLA, Letter of Acceptance (LOA), Special Conditi ons of Contract (SCC), this Scope of Work and written instructions issu ed by the Railway Administration shall form integral parts of the contra ct. 2. Nature and Period of Service The work consists of hiring one non-AC vehicle of Maruti Suzuki Ertiga/ Mahindra XUV/Scorpio or equivalent/same or higher segment, complet e with driver, for a period of two years for official use of the Senior Divi

sional Commercial Manager Mumbai Central. The vehicle shall be depl oyed as directed by Sr DCM/BCT or the authorized Railway official. 3. Place of Deployment The vehicle shall normally be based at DRM Office, Mumbai Central, or at the official residence or any other location as directed by Sr DCM/BC T/authorized Railway official. The contractor shall not claim additional payment merely on account of change in reporting location within the normal area of operation. 4. Duty Hours and Reporting The normal duty hours will start from 08 AM or as per advice b y Railway officials. The vehicle shall be made available on all days a s required by the Railway Administration, including Sundays/holiday s when official duty so requires. (However weekly rest to be m anaged by successful bidder/contractor on his own cost and ar rangement of driver) Reporting time, release time and reporting loc ation may be changed according to operational requirements. Require ments beyond normal duty hours arising from emergency, accident, un usual occurrence, inspection or other official exigency shall be dealt wi th strictly as per the GeM Contract/SLA and applicable contractual pay ment provisions. 5. Official Use and Area of Operation The vehicle shall be used for movement of Sr DCM/BCT and/or authoriz ed Railway officials between DRM Office, official residence, stations, go ods sheds, freight terminals, sidings, Railway establishments, work site s, adjoining areas and other locations as required by the officers. It ma y be required during inspections, accidents, emergencies, unusual occ urrences, special drives and other exigencies. The vehicle may ply on kutcha roads, approach roads, Railway service roads, goods sheds and roads adjoining Railway installations wherever legally and physically p ermissible. No extra claim shall be entertained solely due to road condi tions. 6. Monthly Kilometre Limit and Additional Kilometres The monthly hiring charges shall cover operation up to 1500 km per m

onth. Any kilometers beyond 1500 km in a month shall be payable stri ctly at the rate and under the conditions stipulated in the GeM Contrac t/SLA. No payment shall be admissible for unauthorised/private use of t he vehicle. Outstation duty hours-24x7 as per GeM contract/SLA . 7. Vehicle Category, Age and Condition The vehicle shall be Maruti Suzuki Ertiga/Mahindra XUV/Scorpio or equi valent/same or higher segment as accepted under the applicable GeM category. It shall be commercially/tourist registered, roadworthy, properly maintained and fit for continuous official operation. The vehi cle shall not be more than two years old on the date of initial d eployment. It shall remain in good physical and mechanical condition throughout the contract period and shall be free from defects affecting safety, reliability or appearance. Document related to purchase year of the vehicle shall be produced on demand. 8. Statutory Documents and Permits The contractor shall maintain valid Registration Certificate, insurance, f itness certificate, permit, Pollution Under Control Certificate, road tax a nd all other statutory documents required under applicable law. The ve hicle shall possess valid authorization/permit for operation in Maharash tra, Gujarat and any other State/area. All related costs shall be borne b y the contractor. 9. Driver The contractor shall provide an experienced, skilled, medically and phy sically fit driver possessing a valid and appropriate driving license & P olice verification. The driver shall be conversant with Mumbai, Gujarat and adjoining areas and major Railway locations, and shall be capable of using navigation facilities where required. Driver deployed should pr eferably be from local area of Mumbai central or nearby for uninterrupt ed service. The driver shall maintain discipline, courtesy and proper be haviour and shall not operate the vehicle under the influence of alcoho l, narcotic or intoxicating substances. 10. Driver Uniform, Mobile and Conduct The driver shall wear a neat and presentable uniform consisting of whi te/sky-blue shirt and navy-blue/black trousers, or such other uniform a

s approved by Railway Administration shall be provided by bidder on hi s own cost. A working mobile phone shall be available and the driver s hall remain reachable while on duty. The driver shall not use a mobile phone while driving except through legally permissible hands-free/eme rgency arrangements. 11. Fuel, Maintenance and All-Inclusive Expenses The contractor shall bear all expenses necessary for uninterrupted ope ration and proper upkeep of the vehicle, including fuel, lubricants, driv er wages, statutory payments, servicing, repairs, tyres, batteries, insur ance, permits, taxes, toll charges, parking charges, insurances, FASTag charges and required accessories viz, curtains, air fresheners, tissue papers etc. No additional payment shall be admissible except w here specifically provided in the GeM Contract/SLA. 12. Cleanliness and Safety The vehicle shall be maintained in clean, neat and presentable conditio n at all times. Interior and exterior shall be cleaned daily and seat cove rs/towels shall be maintained in clean condition. Deep cleaning/wash s hall be done regularly once in a month. The vehicle shall have a servic eable spare wheel, jack, wheel spanner, first-aid box, fire extinguisher and all other mandatory safety equipment. Lights, indicators, horn, bra kes, tyres, wipers, speedometer, odometer and other safety-related eq uipment shall remain functional. Contractor shall provide Govt. of India ’ board on front and back side of the vehicle. 13. Odometer and Instrument Integrity The odometer, speedometer and other meters/instruments shall remai n functional and accurate. Any tampering with the odometer or other v ehicle instrument shall be treated as a serious breach of contract and s hall invite action under the applicable contractual provisions. 14. Breakdown and Replacement Vehicle In case of breakdown, accident, mechanical failure, defect or inability o f the vehicle to perform duty, the contractor shall provide a suitable re placement vehicle of the same or higher category, in good condition, a t no extra cost, preferably within two hours of intimation. Failure to pro

vide a replacement may result in the Railway arranging alternate trans port at the risk and cost of the contractor, in addition to deductions/pe nalties applicable under the GeM Contract/SLA. 15. Change/Replacement of Vehicle or Driver No change of vehicle or driver shall be made without prior approval/inti mation as applicable under the contract, except in an emergency, in w hich case immediate intimation shall be given and a suitable replacem ent shall be deployed. Railway Administration may require replacemen t of any vehicle or driver found unsuitable, unsafe, improperly maintai ned or unsatisfactory in performance or behaviour. A driver required to be replaced for unsatisfactory conduct/performance shall be replaced promptly and, wherever specifically required, within 24 hours. 16. Driver Absence In case of absence/leave of the driver, the contractor shall arra nge a suitable substitute driver having valid credentials so tha t official work is not affected. The substitute shall comply with all r equirements applicable to the original driver. 17. Logbook/Log Sheet A proper daily logbook/log sheet shall be maintained showing date, rep orting time, release time, opening and closing odometer readings, kilo meters run, visited and certification/signature of the MCTO/GTR or auth orized Railway official. Corrections shall be duly authenticated. The cer tified log sheets shall be submitted with the monthly bill. 18. Monthly Bill and Payment Monthly payment shall be processed subject to satisfactory performan ce, certification by Sr DCM/BCT or authorized Railway official, submissi on of duly certified log sheets and all documents required under the G eM Contract/SLA. Payment shall be regulated strictly according to the accepted GeM Contract/SLA rates and conditions. 19. Penalty and Deductions Any late reporting, absence/non-availability of vehicle or driver, failure to provide replacement vehicle, breakdown attributable to deficient m aintenance, non-compliance with instructions or other service deficienc y shall attract deductions/penalties strictly as provided in the GeM Con

tract/SLA. Such deductions/penalties shall be without prejudice to othe r remedies available to the Railway Administration under the contract and GCC for Services, 2018. 20. Risk and Cost / Alternate Arrangement If the contractor fails to provide the vehicle/service as required, the Rai lway Administration may, wherever permissible under the applicable c ontractual provisions, make alternate arrangements at the risk and cos t of the contractor. The expenditure so incurred shall be recoverable fr om amounts due to the contractor or otherwise in accordance with the contract. 21. Performance Guarantee The successful bidder shall submit Performance Guarantee equivalent to 5% of the contract value within the prescribed period in accordance with the applicable Railway Board instructions and GCC for Services, 2 018 and its correction slips if any. Delay in submission shall attract penal interest/other consequences as applicable under the governing c ontractual provisions. 22. Termination / Determination and Forfeiture of Performance Guarantee In case of persistent or repeated default, non-performance, abandonm ent of service, repeated non-availability of vehicle/driver, failure to pro vide replacement vehicle, serious breach of contractual conditions or o ther defaults covered under GCC/GeM Contract, Railway Administration shall be entitled to take action in accordance with the applicable provis ions of GCC for Services, 2018 and the GeM Contract/SLA, including iss uance of performance notice where prescribed, determination/terminat ion of the contract, encashment/forfeiture of Performance Guarantee a nd arrangement of balance service at the risk and cost of the contracto r, as applicable. Termination shall be carried out in accordance with th e procedure and notice requirements prescribed in the governing contr act. 23. Contractor's Responsibility and Labour Compliance The contractor shall be solely responsible for payment of wages, statut ory benefits, insurance, compensation and all liabilities relating to the driver/personnel engaged by him. The contractor shall comply with all

applicable Central Government, State Government, local authority, lab our, motor vehicle and other statutory laws, rules, regulations and noti fications. No employer-employee relationship shall exist between Railw ay Administration and the contractor's personnel. 24. Indemnity and Liability The contractor shall indemnify and keep the Railway Administration in demnified against claims, liabilities, damages, losses, compensation, p enalties, legal proceedings and expenses arising from any accident, inj ury, death, damage to property, negligence, default or act/omission att ributable to the contractor, driver or personnel deployed under the con tract. 25. Ownership / Lawful Possession The vehicle shall be owned by the contractor or legally available to the contractor through a valid agreement/authorization. Documentary pro of of ownership/lawful possession and authority to deploy the vehicle s hall be furnished whenever demanded by Railway Administration. 26. FASTag and GPS The contractor shall ensure that FASTag remains active and adequatel y recharged at all times. Delay or detention due to insufficient FASTag balance shall be the responsibility of the contractor 27. Unauthorized Use and Security The vehicle shall not be used for unauthorized private or commercial p urposes during Railway duty. Unauthorized passengers/materials shall not be carried where such carriage may compromise safety or official f unctioning. The driver shall not leave the vehicle unattended during du ty hours without ensuring its safety and shall not hand over the vehicle keys to any unauthorized person. 28. Inspection and Verification Railway Administration reserves the right to inspect the vehicle, verify statutory documents and driver's credentials and assess the condition, cleanliness, safety and performance of the vehicle at any time during t he contract period. 29. Subletting / Assignment

The contractor shall not sublet, transfer or assign the whole or any part of the contract without prior written approval of Railway Administr ation, except where specifically permitted under the GeM Contract. 30. Authorized Representative The contractor shall nominate an authorized representative with a wor king mobile number for coordination and shall ensure immediate respo nse to complaints, breakdowns, replacement requirements and other o perational matters. 31. Force Majeure Force Majeure shall be governed by the applicable provisions of GCC fo r Services, 2018 and the GeM Contract/SLA. 32. Dispute Resolution and Other Matters Dispute resolution, jurisdiction, notices, modification/variation, contract administration and all other matters not specifically covered in this Sco pe of Work shall be governed by the GCC for Services, 2018, applicable amendments, GeM Contract/SLA and other applicable Railway contract ual provisions. 33. No Extra Claim Except for payments expressly admissible under the accepted GeM Co ntract/SLA, the contractor shall not be entitled to any additional payme nt. 34. Compliance with Instructions The contractor and driver shall strictly comply with lawful instructions i ssued by Sr DCM/BCT or the authorized Railway official regarding repor ting, deployment, route, official movement, safety and operational req uirements. Repeated failure to comply with such instructions shall be d ealt with under the applicable contractual provisions. 35. Final Applicability All conditions contained in this Scope of Work shall be read together wi th the GCC for Services, 2018, applicable amendments/correction slips, Railway Board instructions and the GeM Contract/SLA. In the event of a ny matter not specifically provided herein, the applicable provisions of the governing contractual documents shall apply.

36. Discontinuity of vehicle The vehicle service may be discontinued intermittently during the cont ract period whenever the post remains vacant or the incumbent officer does not opt for/utilize the official vehicle. No payment shall be admissi ble for the period during which the vehicle service is discontinued. 37. Non-availability of service In case of non-reporting/non-provision of the vehicle on any day, the a pplicable per-day vehicle hire charges shall be deducted on a pro-rata basis, in addition to any penalty leviable under the terms and condition s of the contract. .
